At Margherita's, Ciaccona now sings a song about that battle. Woven into that song is a tale of a mysterious man from Huanglong. As you listen, his story unfolds before your eyes...

His name is Qiuyuan. He appeared in Ragunna City, originally in search of Fenrico, Primus of the Order of the Deep. But before long, the city was struck by the Dark Tide and its spawn. By then, you had already departed for Avinoleum to seek Cartethyia's aid concerning the Civilization Capsule...

Qiuyuan fights alone, driving back Tidespawn in the streets and rescuing an Acolyte in the middle of evacuating civilians. Carlotta and the others soon arrive to help, guiding the civilians to seek sanctuary at the Cathedral of Mercury and Averardo Vault. Because Qiuyuan is not from Rinascita, the Dark Tide does not harm him. Instead, it allows him to sense you in pursuit of Galbrena, far away in Avinoleum...

Qiuyuan arrives in Avinoleum. By then, Cartethyia has already been killed by Galbrena, and you have left in pursuit. Only Cantarella remains. She recognizes Qiuyuan as a former high official of Mingting. He tells her someone in Mingting has sent him to aid you, and through his Mindsight ability, he perceives the Mark of the Dark Tide clinging to you...

Following Cantarella's clues, Qiuyuan finds Fenrico at the Fabricatorium of the Deep, only to be blocked by an illusion of an Acolyte, a Fractsidus member in disguise. Qiuyuan instantly recognizes "him" as the one who killed his Grandmaster. Yet he also knows this figure is only a projection, not the true "killer." The man declares he will not stop Qiuyuan and steps aside, saying only by letting him pass will Fenrico's destiny be fulfilled...

The First Relic draws on Qiuyuan's Mindsight to manifest the Cathedral of Mercury. There, the lingering consciousness of Fenrico confesses his ideals and intentions. To allow Qiuyuan to take the Relic and deliver it to you, Fenrico must finally accept his own death and find release. Perhaps it was fate that brought them to this moment, for Qiuyuan too is burdened by a regret over a past choice involving the Threnodian...

Qiuyuan once faced a difficult choice. Ordered by the Mingting Censorate to kill Geshu Lin, Qiuyuan hesitated, seeing that the man had not yet fallen to darkness. He saw the raging fire churning in the man's heart, but just as his own teacher once cautioned him, he urged Geshu Lin to wield his power with restraint. In defying the Censorate's command, he spared Geshu Lin's life.

Through the Dark Tide, Fenrico glimpses these memories. Because Geshu Lin did eventually fall to darkness, guilt has haunted Qiuyuan ever since. But history grants no second chances. All that remains for both Fenrico and Qiuyuan is to fulfill their missions. Choosing to trust Qiuyuan, Fenrico hands the First Relic and the task of defeating Leviathan to him. With that, his soul vanishes into the depths of the Fabricatorium.

Through Ciaccona's Forte, you glimpse Qiuyuan's journey across Rinascita. But since the battle in Septimont, you haven't seen him again, nor do you know where to find him to offer your thanks.

In the end, you find Qiuyuan just before he boards a merchant ship bound for Mengzhou. He tells you he came to Rinascita to aid you at someone's request, and Scar was merely a side matter. The two of you are but strangers whose paths happened to cross. But the world is wide, the road is long. The nation's political, economic, and cultural center. * Ministry of Sentinel Affairs - A special agency responsible for monitoring Sentinels, astronomy, and calendars across Huanglong's various cities. Led by the Minister of Sentinel Affairs in Mingting, it has subordinate bureaus in the other six cities, each headed by a Supervisor. While they hold independent authority on Sentinel-related matters, they are limited to advising and supervising the administrative bodies of each city and Mingting. * Internal Security Agency - An institution that operates independently of the administrative, judicial, and military branches of Huanglong, with the highest official titled "Chief Commander." Reporting directly to the Emperor of Huanglong, it holds the authority to investigate any case, official, or criminal without approval from other agencies, with the power to "act first, report later." Tasked with handling intricate cases year-round, the agency has developed specialized expertise in managing Resonators. * Grand Marshal - As the highest official in Huanglong's Ministry of War, the Minister oversees all military affairs for the six cities in Huanglong. The honorific title "Grand Marshal" is used to signify the rank and authority of this position. * Censorate - One of Huanglong's three judicial bodies. It holds the authority to jointly try major cases and wields significant supervisory power, a duty summarized as "to probe evil and maintain discipline." Its officials are generally titled Censors, while those stationed or assigned temporarily in the six cities are called Investigating Censors. * Fenrico the First - Just as the name enjoyed by Napoli the Second, it is a title Primus Fenrico should have rightfully possessed. However, due to unknown reasons, Fenrico forbade Acolytes from referring to him as such, until he met his end at the bottom of the sea.
